* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northeastern Franklin County in central Ohio...
Southeastern Delaware County in central Ohio...
Western Licking County in central Ohio...

* Until 830 PM EDT.

* At 748 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Sunbury,
moving east at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to trees and power lines.

* Locations impacted include...
Columbus, Westerville, Worthington, Granville, Pataskala,
Johnstown, Sunbury, Utica, Beechwood Trails, Granville South,
Polaris, New Albany, Jersey, Galena, Alexandria, Hartford,

properties.instruction:

building.

Large hail, damaging wind, and continuous cloud to ground lightning

one of nature's leading killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder,
you are close enough to be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

To report severe weather, go to our website at weather.gov/iln and
submit your report via social media, when you can do so safely.

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued August 8 at 6:13PM CDT by NWS Midland/Odessa TX
properties.description:
At 612 PM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 7
miles west of Garden City, moving west at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph and half inch hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Garden City and Spraberry.
properties.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

This storm may intensify, so be certain to monitor local radio
stations and available television stations for additional information
and possible warnings from the National Weather Service.

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued August 8 at 7:10PM EDT by NWS Wilmington OH
properties.description:
At 710 PM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located near Sunbury, moving
east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph, frequent cloud-to-ground
lightning, and very heavy rain.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Lightning can cause serious injury or
death. Visibility will be poor and hydroplaning is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Westerville, Delaware, Johnstown, Sunbury, Utica, Galena, Hartford,
Interstate 71 at US Route 36/State Route 37, Alum Creek State Park,
Fredonia, US Route 62 at State Route 661, Olive Green, Center
Village, Lewis Center, and Kilbourne.

This includes I-71 in Ohio between mile markers 123 and 135.

If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a sturdy building.

Motorists should slow down and use extra caution.

When thunder roars, go indoors! Do not stay in the open or seek
shelter under trees when lightning threatens.

To report hazardous weather conditions, go to our website at
weather.gov/iln and submit your report via social media, when you can
do so safely.
